narrative_vs_numbers.point: Revenue growth accelerated sharply from 20.3% in Mar 2026 to 75.1% YoY in Sep 2026.
Reported FY26 total income of ₹1,00,469 cr vs management claimed total income of ₹1,02,943 cr.
Free cash flow plunged further negative to -₹30,993 cr in FY26 despite operational project completions.
Operating cash flow fell to ₹2,357 cr in FY26, bringing OCF/PAT conversion down to 0.24.

bull: Revenue growth accelerated to 75.1% YoY in Sep 2026 quarter with EBITDA reaching ₹5,509 crore.
Debt-to-Equity improved from 1.82 in Mar 2025 to 1.2 by Sep 2026 following equity infusion.
Key mega-projects commissioned including Navi Mumbai Airport and Ganga Expressway.
bear: Free cash flow worsened to -₹30,993 crore in FY26 as capex requirements remained high.
Operating cash flow conversion plummeted to 0.24x OCF/PAT in FY26 from 3.87x in FY21.
Total borrowings expanded to ₹1,17,933 crore by Sep 2026.
watch: Next fiscal EBITDA addition from Navi Mumbai, Kutch Copper, and Ganga Expressway against ₹3,000 cr target.
FY27 capex trajectory towards the guided ₹40,000 crore level.
Solar cell line completion progress against updated September 30, 2026 target.
